changelog: Fixed Codex not installing: dpkg/apt binaries carry a compiled-in com.termux config path that this package can never read (dpkg.cfg.d 'Permission denied'), so the Termux package route is skipped and Codex is installed from the official static build instead (sha256-verified, no dpkg needed)

Fixed cloud agents ('failed to connect to AGI hub, Expected gRPC but was 404'): the rootfs bundled an old agy CLI (1.2.16) whose hub does not have the cloud routes — the app now auto-updates agy to the latest version before starting the hub (watch the server log for 'agy updated')
Fixed TLS downloads from the terminal and installers: curl/npm now get CURL_CA_BUNDLE and SSL_CERT_FILE pointed at this package's own CA bundle instead of the blocked com.termux path
Upstream 1.1.8 features from the previous build stay: Connect to PC, folder tabs in Files, subagents in the side bar, WebView DevTools
